/hero/tagline.source_en: Busan's seaside temple at its quiet hour, a glass skywalk over the sea, a pastel capsule ride down the coast, and two hillside villages — one famous, one still local

/catalog_card/title.source_en: Busan Small-Group: Sea Temple, Sky Capsule & Culture Villages

/catalog_card/subtitle.source_en: Small-group day tour of Busan's coastal icons and hillside villages — ⟦G1⟧ seaside temple, the Cheongsapo Daritdol glass skywalk, the Blueline Park Sky Capsule ride (ticket optional at booking), ⟦G0⟧, and the quiet Dakbatgol mural village with its wish-stairs monorail.

/catalog_card/shortCardDescription.source_en: A small-group Busan day built around the coast and the hillside villages: ⟦G1⟧ seaside temple in its quiet morning window, the free glass-floor Daritdol Observatory at Cheongsapo, the Blueline Park Sky Capsule ride from Cheongsapo to Mipo (ticket included or excluded — choose at booking), lunch, ⟦G0⟧, and the little-known Dakbatgol mural village where a free monorail glides up the 'wish stairs'. Every anchor except the optional capsule is free admission.

/pickup_dropoff/notes/0.source_en: Pickup is door-to-door at your central Busan hotel between 09:00 and 10:00; the exact time is confirmed the evening before. Drop-offs are at four central points in sequence (Nampo-dong → Busan Station → Seomyeon → Haeundae, ≈ 17:10–18:20) — tell the guide during the afternoon which one you want.

/pickup_dropoff/departure/0/note.source_en: Door-to-door pickup at hotels in central Busan — Seomyeon, Nampo-dong / Busan Station, Haeundae / Marine City. Your exact time is confirmed the evening before.
